'''Ono-Mi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss commandos|Voss Commando]] living on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3640 BBY]] he was assisting Commando [[Biddeck-Va]] at his base in the [[Gormak Lands]]. When the [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]] sought the audience with Biddeck-Va, Ono-Mi explained that he was on a mission against the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] chieftains that could last for months. Only if the chieftains were all defeated, could Biddeck-Va return from his duty. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] had no time to wait and simply slaughtered all Gormak all alone, to the surprise of both Ono-Mi and Biddeck-Va. Ono-Mi was then slaughtered when the Wrath stole Biddeck-Va's trinket.<ref name="TOR" />
